headline: The Sindh government decided on Thursday to launch a large-scale crackdown to remove encroachments from major roads in Karachi, including University Road and People's Bus Service routes, Dawn reports.

card.desc: Police and city officials will act together, Sindh govt says.

caption:
Big crackdown coming on Karachi's main roads!
According to Dawn, the Sindh government decided on Thursday to remove encroachments from major roads in Karachi. In the first phase, action will be taken on main roads, including University Road, and along People's Bus Service routes. Police, the city administration and the transport department will act together. The meeting was chaired by Senior Minister Sharjeel Inam Memon.
